title: Filemanager Provider Health
description: Provider operation volume/latency/error health segmented by provider and mount_id. Runbook: https://runbooks.example.internal/filemanager/provider-health

panels.title: Operation volume by provider/mount
panels.description: Request throughput for mounted and default providers. Runbook: https://runbooks.example.internal/filemanager/provider-health#throughput

panels.title: Provider latency p50 by operation/mount
panels.description: p50 latency trend segmented by provider and mount_id. Runbook: https://runbooks.example.internal/filemanager/provider-health#latency
panels.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, operation, provider, mount_id) (rate(filemgr_provider_operation_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])))

panels.title: Provider latency p95 by operation/mount
panels.description: p95 latency trend segmented by provider and mount_id. Runbook: https://runbooks.example.internal/filemanager/provider-health#latency
panels.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, operation, provider, mount_id) (rate(filemgr_provider_operation_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])))

panels.title: Provider error rate by class
panels.expr: sum by (provider, mount_id, error_class) (rate(filemgr_provider_errors_total[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (provider, mount_id) (rate(filemgr_provider_operation_total[10m])), 1)

panels.title: Provider 5xx rate
panels.expr: sum by (provider, mount_id) (rate(filemgr_provider_errors_total{error_class="server_error"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (provider, mount_id) (rate(filemgr_provider_operation_total[10m])), 1)

panels.title: iCloud rollout decisions by reason/cohort
panels.description: Feature-gate decisions segmented by reason, cohort, mode, and environment. Runbook: https://runbooks.example.internal/filemanager/provider-health#rollout-controls

panels.title: iCloud rollout deny ratio
panels.description: Ratio of denied rollout decisions (kill switch / denylist / allowlist miss / unknown mode). Runbook: https://runbooks.example.internal/filemanager/provider-health#rollout-controls

panels.title: Mount reconcile batch outcomes
panels.description: Batch reconcile run outcomes split by dry-run mode. Runbook: https://runbooks.example.internal/filemanager/provider-health#reconcile

panels.title: Mount reconcile drift items by type
panels.description: Detected metadata drift by item kind from mount reconcile jobs. Runbook: https://runbooks.example.internal/filemanager/provider-health#reconcile

panels.title: Mount reconcile p95 duration
panels.description: p95 latency for mount reconcile batches. Runbook: https://runbooks.example.internal/filemanager/provider-health#reconcile

alerts.name: FilemanagerICloudRolloutDenySpike
alerts.description: iCloud rollout deny ratio exceeded 20% for 15m. Runbook: https://runbooks.example.internal/filemanager/provider-health#rollout-controls

alerts.name: FilemanagerMountReconcileErrorRate
alerts.description: Mount reconcile error rate exceeded 10% for 15m. Runbook: https://runbooks.example.internal/filemanager/provider-health#reconcile
